13811.name: A Small Crack

north.description: To the north lies Moloch's Repose.

east.description: To the east lies The Stone Of Sealing.

13811.description:
A Small Crack splits the black rock here, barely wide enough for a grown
man to squeeze through sideways. The stone is hot under your palm, and a
dull red light seeps from deep in the fissure. Veins of glassy rock wind
along the walls, and the air tastes of sulphur and old smoke. The crack
opens north into a larger hollow, and east onto a sealed-looking stone.

13849.name: A Hot Cave Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

13849.description:
A Hot Cave Tunnel winds through rock the colour of dried blood, where
the walls are too warm to rest a hand upon. Sweat runs down your neck in
the stifling air, and the floor crackles with fine black grit. A faint
orange glow lights the passage east, while the tunnel falls away south
into a hotter dark.

13850.name: A Hot Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Natural Lava-Chamber.

13850.description:
A Hot Cave Tunnel runs through reddened rock, broad and low, where the
heat beats against you in waves. Rivulets of cooled lava have frozen
along the floor in twisted ropes, and your boots stumble over them. A
fierce orange light spills in from a hollow on one side. The tunnel runs
north and south, and an opening west leads to a molten chamber.

13851.name: Natural Lava-Chamber

east.description: To the east lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

13851.description:
The Natural Lava-Chamber is a huge bubble in the rock, its floor a lake
of slow, glowing lava that heaves and sighs like something alive. Black
crusts of stone drift on its surface and crack open to show the white-
hot heart beneath. The heat is monstrous, and the light blinding,
throwing your shadow high on the roof. The only path is the tunnel east.

13852.name: A Hot Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Fire Vein.

13852.description:
The Hot Cave Tunnel grows narrower here, and the walls glow a dull
cherry colour. Scalding air rushes from a gap at the end, bringing with
it a deep bellowing roar. The floor is dry and cracked, with flakes of
black stone curling up at the edges. The tunnel runs north, and the
passage opens east on a blazing cut in the rock.

13853.name: The Fire Vein

south.description: To the south lies On A Stone Ledge.

west.description: To the west lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

13853.description:
The Fire Vein is a great seam of molten rock that cuts across the cavern
in a river of white-gold light, hissing and spitting as it flows. The
heat is nearly unbearable, and the air shakes with it. A narrow shelf of
stone runs along the edge, scorched and crumbling. The hot tunnel lies
west, and the shelf continues south.

13854.name: On A Stone Ledge

north.description: To the north lies The Fire Vein.

west.description: To the west lies At The Entrance To The Under Tombs.

13854.description:
On A Stone Ledge you edge along a narrow shelf above a glowing chasm,
the rock hot underfoot and flecked with ash. Far below, a river of fire
crawls slowly through the dark, lighting the cavern in shifting red. A
rising updraft of heat tugs at your cloak. The ledge runs north along
the fire, and west toward a dark archway.

13855.name: At The Entrance To The Under Tombs

east.description: To the east lies On A Stone Ledge.

down.description: To the down lies The Hall Of Mirrors.

13855.description:
At The Entrance To The Under Tombs, an archway of black stone is carved
with a ring of pallid faces, their eyes closed, their mouths open in
silent song. A cold, sweet air drifts up from within, strangely free of
the cavern's heat. Worn stairs spiral steeply into the dark. The ledge
lies east, and the stairs lead down.

extra_descs.faces archway carved faces:
A ring of pale stone faces circles the arch, each one different. Their
lips are parted as though in the middle of a hymn.

13856.name: The Hall Of Mirrors

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall Of The Pale.

up.description: To the up lies At The Entrance To The Under Tombs.

13856.description:
The Hall Of Mirrors is a long gallery lined with tall panels of black
glass, each framed in tarnished silver. In them your reflection moves a
moment too late, and sometimes shows you wearing a different face, or no
face at all. The air is bitterly cold and perfectly still. A door at the
far end leads south into a great hall, and a stair climbs back to the
entrance.

extra_descs.mirrors panels glass:
The black glass shows your own shape, but off by a breath, and the room
behind you is never quite the room you stand in.

13857.name: The Great Hall Of The Pale

north.description: To the north lies The Hall Of Mirrors.

south.description: To the south lies The Stone Of Sealing.

13857.description:
The Great Hall Of The Pale is a vast chamber of white stone, its ceiling
lost in shadow and its floor laid with rows of silent stone slabs. Tall
pillars carved as robed figures hold up the vault, and each wears the
same serene, empty smile. Cold blue light falls from no visible source,
and your footsteps echo strangely. A door north leads to the mirrors,
and another door south leads on toward a great stone.

13858.name: The Tomb Of The Pale

north.description: To the north lies The Stone Of Sealing.

south.description: To the south lies Moloch's Repose.

13858.description:
The Tomb Of The Pale is a long chamber of grey stone, lined with niches
that hold the bodies of an ancient sect, wrapped in bleached linen.
Their faces, where the cloth has slipped, are white as candle wax and
strangely untouched by time. A low red glow creeps up the walls from
cracks in the floor. The tomb runs north to a great carved stone, and
south toward a heavier heat.

13859.name: Moloch's Repose

south.description: To the south lies A Small Crack.

13859.description:
Moloch's Repose is a vaulted pit of black stone, where the heat presses
against your face like an open furnace. A great sarcophagus of fused
obsidian lies on a dais of cracked basalt, wound about with chains of
dull iron. Veins of molten light pulse slowly in the floor, as though
the rock itself breathed. Only the small crack leads away south.

13862.name: The Stone Of Sealing

south.description: To the south lies The Tomb Of The Pale.

13862.description:
The Stone Of Sealing is a slab of pale rock as wide as a barn door, set
upright into the cave wall and carved from edge to edge with warding
glyphs. Ash lies in drifts at its foot, scorched where something tried
to break through long ago. A dry, throbbing heat leaks around its edges,
and the glyphs glow faintly red. The only way back is south, into the
Tomb Of The Pale.

13863.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies The Granite Stairs.

13863.description:
A rough stair of granite leads up out of the Glowing Tunnel here, its
worn treads wide and shallow, with the charred stumps of an old
barricade standing to either side. A cool breath of cleaner air drifts
down it, a sweet contrast with the choking heat. The tunnel runs north,
south and west, and the steps climb toward an older, drier country.

13864.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13864.description:
The Glowing Tunnel runs straight here for a long stretch, its walls
streaked with bands of black, red and ochre like a layered cake. The
roof is cracked and sags in places, and a few fallen slabs lie across
the floor. The heat has an oily weight, and the glow pulses faintly in
time with a distant beat. The tunnel goes north and south.

13865.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13865.description:
This Glowing Tunnel bends where two long cracks meet, the floor split by
a seam of bright, living ember. Ash curls from it in lazy ribbons, and
the rock on either side is blistered and flaking. A hot wind sighs
through the passage and tugs at your clothes. The tunnel leads north,
and west around the corner.

13866.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13866.description:
A Glowing Tunnel with walls pocked by hundreds of tiny holes, as though
the stone were a sponge, each one glinting red from within. The floor is
rutted and strewn with pebbles of black glass. A distant bubbling sound
comes from somewhere beyond the rock. Here the tunnel bends, running
north and east.

13867.name: A Glowing Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13867.description:
The Glowing Tunnel turns sharply here around a heap of collapsed rock,
the fallen stone fused together in a single dark mass. A thin scarlet
light runs through its crevices like blood through veins. The air is dry
as a bake-oven. You can go south or west from here.

13868.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13868.description:
A Glowing Tunnel with a high, narrow roof, the rock overhead streaked
white where mineral water once ran and has long since boiled away.
Brittle crusts crack beneath your feet. A smell of hot metal and struck
flint hangs in the air. The tunnel winds north and east.

13869.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13869.description:
This Glowing Tunnel is carved with faint, ancient marks, rows of runes
cut by some long-lost hand and half-melted by heat. They glow with a
pale orange light that seems brighter than the rock around them. The
floor is warm and dry, scattered with a few pieces of broken pottery.
The passage runs east and south.

13870.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13870.description:
A Glowing Tunnel joins three ways here in a ragged hollow where the
ceiling is lost in smoke. Cinders crunch in drifts along the walls, and
an ember-coloured haze hangs in the still air. The rock shows the marks
of old pick work, long since scorched. Passages lead north, east and
west.

13871.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13871.description:
The Glowing Tunnel here is a short, straight run of smooth stone, its
walls glazed as though by a giant's kiln. Your footsteps ring on the
floor, and a dull glow rises from below in the cracks. Streaks of soot
reach the roof. The way leads on north, and back south.

13872.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13872.description:
Three tunnels meet in this Glowing Tunnel, where the rock widens into a
sooty vault shot through with seams of red. A pile of charred rubble
lies against one wall, and the air above it shivers with heat. A dry
roaring sound comes from the stone, rising and falling like a slow
breath. Passages lead north, east and south.

13873.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13873.description:
At this bend the Glowing Tunnel opens into a small chamber with a
smooth, scorched floor, as though a great fire once burned here. Soot
blackens the walls to head height, and fragments of burnt bone lie in
the cinders. Heat shimmers over the stone in rippling waves. Ways lead
east, west and south from here.

13874.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13874.description:
This stretch of the Glowing Tunnel slopes gently, its floor worn into a
smooth channel as if a long-dried stream of fire had once flowed here.
Beads of cooled rock hang from the ceiling like dark glass tears. The
glow is strongest at the lowest point, a deep and brooding red. The
tunnel runs north and south from here.

13875.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13875.description:
A Glowing Tunnel narrows here to a throat of rough, spiky stone, its
walls studded with sharp crystals the colour of coals. Every breath
scalds the lungs, and tiny sparks leap from the dry rock when your boots
strike it. A shaft of red radiance spills from a side seam. The tunnel
runs north and west.

13876.name: A Glowing Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13876.description:
The Glowing Tunnel curves here around a pillar of fused rock that looks
like melted wax. A film of orange light dances on the polished surface,
and your reflection wavers in it like a ghost in water. The air stinks
of burnt iron. The passage drops south toward a wider cavity and runs
west back along the tunnel.

13877.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13877.description:
This Glowing Tunnel is low and long, with a crust of iridescent mineral
running along the roof that glimmers green and violet in the heat-light.
The floor is warm as a hearthstone and covered in a fine pale dust.
Somewhere far off, stone grinds against stone with a slow, patient
rhythm. The passage runs east and west, each way a little hotter than
the last.

13878.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13878.description:
A Glowing Tunnel meets two others here in a small, round junction of
blackened rock. The ceiling is lost in smoke, and ash settles gently on
your shoulders like dark snow. Pale light comes from a seam in the
floor, illuminating the heaps of cinder along the walls. Ways lead east
and west along the tunnel, and a passage runs south.

13879.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13879.description:
Another Glowing Tunnel, this one broad and sloping, with a floor of
ribbed stone that crunches with ash. The walls are marked with deep
scratches, as though by iron claws, running in long parallel lines.
Light wells from the cracks below, painting everything in dull red and
gold. The tunnel goes east toward a junction, and south back toward the
narrower reaches.

13880.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13880.description:
A Glowing Tunnel runs between walls of smooth, reddish rock that seem to
shine from within. Small bubbles of cooled stone, like frozen froth,
crust the ceiling and click softly in the rising draught. A sharp tang
of brimstone fills your nose. The passage runs north toward a brighter
glow and west back along the way you came.

13881.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13881.description:
The Glowing Tunnel here is narrow and low, the roof just above your head
and crusted with fused black glass. Thin threads of red light run along
the seams in the rock and flicker as if with a pulse. The heat is steady
and heavy, like a hand on your chest. The tunnel turns east, and returns
south the way you came.

13882.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

13882.description:
This Glowing Tunnel bends sharply through veined rock, each vein shining
a dull, sickly amber like the embers of a banked fire. Your shadow
stretches long and wavering on the opposite wall. The floor is gritty
with cinders, and a distant roar rumbles through the stone. The tunnel
turns north, and a hot passage lies back west.

651400.name: beetle fire ember giant
651400.long_desc: A giant ember beetle scuttles over the hot rock, its black shell glowing at the seams.
651400.description:
A beetle as big as a hound, its shell split by lines of orange light and
its mandibles dripping a smoking spittle.

651401.name: imp cinder small demon
651401.long_desc: A cinder imp capers along the wall, cackling, trailing sparks from its clawed fingers.
651401.description:
A small, wiry fiend of charred red skin, with a long barbed tail and
eyes like glowing coals. It grins a mouthful of needle teeth.

651402.name: wraith mirror ghost
651402.long_desc: A mirror wraith slides out of a black pane, a silvery ghost wearing a dozen stolen faces.
651402.description:
A shape of cold silver mist that mimics your face as you look on it. Its
hands end in shards of broken glass.

651403.name: cultist pale robed
651403.long_desc: A pale cultist in a bone-white robe kneels motionless on the cold stone, murmuring prayers.
651403.description:
A gaunt, hairless figure with skin as white as chalk and eyes sunk deep
in shadow. He wears a robe stitched with silver thread.

651404.name: golem magma lava
651404.long_desc: A hulking magma golem stands in the lava, glowing, a figure of black rock cracked with fire.
651404.description:
A towering figure of black stone, its seams full of liquid fire. Each
step leaves a scorched footprint that smokes.

651405.name: knight pale skeleton armoured
651405.long_desc: A pale knight in bone-coloured plate stands watch beside the slabs, a long sword held before him.
651405.description:
A dead warrior in ancient white armour, pale light shining from the
slits of his helm. His shield bears a faded face with closed eyes.

651406.name: imrael priest pale high wight
651406.long_desc: Imrael, the Pale High Priest, stands in the Hall of Mirrors, a robed figure of ash and silver.
651406.description:
A tall figure in robes of pale grey, a mask of white silver covering its
face. It holds a staff topped with a ring of cold flame, and its
reflection in the glass does not match its movements.

651407.name: moloch demon lord ancient
651407.long_desc: Moloch, the Ancient Demon Lord, rises from his sarcophagus, wreathed in flame and smoke.
651407.description:
A towering demon with the horns of a ram and skin like cooling lava,
wings folded about him like a smoking cloak. His eyes are two pits of
white fire, and the chains about him burn red where they stretch.

751400.name: magma heart ruby glowing
751400.room_desc: A glowing red stone, hot to the eye, lies here.
751400.description: A smouldering gem the size of a fist, holding a slow pulse of liquid fire inside. It sells dear to any jeweller who dares to touch it.

751401.name: mirror shard dagger glass
751401.room_desc: A dagger made of black mirror glass lies here.
751401.description: A slender dagger ground from a shard of black mirror-glass, its edge bright as ice. Your reflection in the blade never quite matches your face.

751402.name: pale knight shield white
751402.room_desc: A white shield painted with a sleeping face lies here.
751402.description: A heavy kite shield of bleached steel, painted with a closed-eyed face. It is cold to the touch even in the cave's heat.

751403.name: pale priest mantle grey cloak
751403.room_desc: A silver-threaded grey mantle lies here.
751403.description: A long mantle of ash-grey cloth embroidered with silver faces, each with closed eyes. It hangs on the shoulders as if made of cold mist.

751404.name: moloch hellblade sword black
751404.room_desc: A black greatsword with a molten edge lies here, glowing.
751404.description: A huge blade of black iron with an edge that still glows dull red, as though newly drawn from the forge. The hilt is wrapped in blistered leather, and the heat of it can be felt from across the room.
